{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Prepared with laser-cut greens and appetizing toppings grown on locally-orbiting VegSatellites.|Dex's Diner menu, on its salads|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
A '''VegSatellite''' was a type of [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] that were used to grow [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served [[Salad/Legends|salads]] with [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] and [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] grown on locally&ndash;[[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] VegSatellites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
VegSatellites were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
